records.SR-003:
---
id: SR-003
title: Links pin both ends
statement: Every link records the content hash of both of its ends, and plumb reports the link as stale when either end's current hash differs from its pin.
examples:
- id: EX-1
  given: a link whose pins are current
  when: the test function body changes
  then: plumb drift reports the link stale and names the target end
---
records.SR-004:
---
id: SR-004
title: Approvals pin exact content
statement: An approval pins the record hash; an edit after the approval leaves the record unconfirmed until the owner approves again.
examples:
- id: EX-1
  given: an approved requirement
  when: its statement is edited
  then: the requirement is an unconfirmed edit
---
